items.pattern: if + had been for a condition that is still true (permanent trait)
items.sk: Podmienka platí stále, preto v Mixed Conditional: „{right}“.
items.cz: Podmínka platí stále, proto v Mixed Conditional: „{right}“.
items.en: The condition is still true, so the Mixed Conditional: “{right}”.

items.pattern: would + base where the result would already have happened
items.sk: Následok by sa už stal, preto „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Následek by už nastal, proto „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: The result would already have happened: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: would have + participle for a result true now
items.en: The result is true now, so “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: would + verb after if
items.en: No “would” after “if”: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: Present Simple after if for an unreal present condition
items.sk: Neskutočnú prítomnú podmienku vyjadruje Past Simple: „{right}“.
items.cz: Neskutečnou přítomnou podmínku vyjadřuje Past Simple: „{right}“.
items.en: An unreal present condition takes Past Simple: “{right}”.

items.pattern: Past Simple after if for a past cause
items.sk: Príčina je v minulosti, preto po „if“ Past Perfect: „{right}“.
items.cz: Příčina je v minulosti, proto po „if“ Past Perfect: „{right}“.
items.en: The cause is in the past, so Past Perfect after “if”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: has/have + participle after if
items.sk: Po „if“ patrí Past Perfect, nie Present Perfect: „{right}“.
items.cz: Po „if“ patří Past Perfect, ne Present Perfect: „{right}“.
items.en: After “if” use Past Perfect, not Present Perfect: “{right}”.

items.pattern: if + I/he/she/it was instead of were
items.en: After “if”, “were” is the standard form: “{right}”.

items.pattern: will instead of would in the result clause
items.en: An unreal result takes “would”, not “will”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: real condition (is/will) instead of an unreal one
items.en: The situation is unreal: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: result clause in plain present/past without would
items.en: The result clause needs “would”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: would had + participle
items.en: After “would” always use “have”, not “had”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: if + had + base form
items.en: After “had” use the past participle: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: unless used for 'if … not' in an unreal condition
items.en: “unless” changes the meaning here; use “if … not”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: when instead of if for an unreal condition
items.en: An unreal condition takes “if”; “when” means it really happens.

items.pattern: yet in a positive clause for 'already'
items.sk: „Už“ v kladnej vete je „already“; „yet“ patrí do záporu a otázok.
items.cz: „Už“ v kladné větě je „already“; „yet“ patří do záporu a otázek.
items.en: Use “already” in a positive clause; “yet” is for negatives and questions.

items.pattern: such + adjective without a noun
items.sk: Pred samotným prídavným menom patrí „so“, nie „such“: „{right}“.
items.cz: Před samotným přídavným jménem patří „so“, ne „such“: „{right}“.
items.en: Before an adjective alone use “so”, not “such”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: more + short adjective (more thick)
items.sk: Krátke prídavné meno stupňujeme príponou: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Krátké přídavné jméno stupňujeme příponou: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: A short adjective takes -er: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: a/an before an uncountable noun (a paper, an advice)
items.en: An uncountable noun takes no “a”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: 'all them' instead of 'them all' / 'all of them'
items.sk: Správne je „them all“ alebo „all of them“, nie „all them“.
items.cz: Správně je „them all“ nebo „all of them“, ne „all them“.
items.en: Say “them all” or “all of them”, not “all them”.
